seo.title: pixsame — visual regression testing for Cypress (Playwright soon)
seo.description: One manifest standard shared by both runners, a pinned renderer for byte-identical screenshots, forensic diff analysis and baseline approval in the pull request.

hero.eyebrow: Open source · MIT · Cypress today, Playwright soon
hero.title: Visual regression that agrees with itself.
hero.body: One manifest standard shared by both runners. A pinned renderer that makes local and CI screenshots byte-identical. Forensic diff analysis instead of a red blob, and baseline approval that happens in the pull request.
hero.soonNote: Available today: the Cypress plugin and the manifest. Coming soon: the pinned renderer, the forensic diff and approval in the pull request.

detect.demo: Illustrative example of an AI detection pass
detect.label: AI detection pass · PR #2841
detect.verdict: One geometry edit, not 5,812 findings. Matches the intent of “increase nav density”.

manifest.title: Shared manifest
manifest.body: One open manifest format for Cypress and Playwright, so reports, bots and review tools work with either runner.

renderer.title: Pinned renderer
renderer.body: Fonts, antialiasing and GPU differences are pinned, so local and CI screenshots come out byte-identical.

forensic.title: Forensic diff
forensic.body: Each change is classified as geometry, text reflow or antialiasing noise, instead of one red blob.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: Review changes in the pull request or in the pixsame platform, whichever your team prefers. Both flows approve the same baselines.

pricing.title: Free where it matters. Paid where it scales.
pricing.body: The core is open source and free. Teams add cloud renders, 30 days of hosted baseline history and support; Enterprise adds the AI auto-evaluator, SSO and an SLA.
pricing.note: Team and Enterprise are coming soon. Prices are indicative and may change before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: This website uses no cookies and no ad tracking. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which counts page views without cookies or fingerprinting.
privacy.p3: Waitlist: if you join, we store your email address, the product you signed up for, your language and the time of your consent. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). We use these data only to email you when that product launches and about later updates to it, including changes to the pixsame ecosystem that are connected to it. We do not use them for anything else and do not share them for marketing.
privacy.p4: Contact form: we use your name, email address and message only to answer you, and delete them when they are no longer needed for that.
privacy.p5: Processors: the forms run on Google Apps Script and Google Sheets (Google), and spam is filtered with Cloudflare Turnstile (Cloudflare). They may process data outside the EU under standard contractual clauses. The forms send what you type to Google as part of the request address.
privacy.p6: Retention and your rights: waitlist data is kept until you withdraw your consent or the product is discontinued. At any time you can withdraw consent and ask for access, correction or erasure by writing to {email}. You can also complain to your data protection authority (in Poland: UODO).
